aBefore=check(Assembly.pair,a=@v/a,b=@v/ma)
bBefore=check(Assembly.pair,a=@v/b,b=@v/mb)
raw=assemble(Assembly.fragments,on=@v/G,along=Assembly.interfaces,a=@v/A,b=@v/B,ma=@v/ma,mb=@v/mb)
aWithin=evaluate(Assembly.within,r=@v/A)
bWithin=evaluate(Assembly.within,r=@v/B)
aProblem=prepare(Assembly.boundary,using=Assembly.choose,on=@v/A,p=@v/ma)
bProblem=prepare(Assembly.boundary,using=Assembly.choose,on=@v/B,p=@v/mb)
bProblemOne=prepare(Assembly.boundaryOne,using=Assembly.choose,on=@v/B,p=@v/mb)
bSolveOne=solve($bProblemOne.problem,within=$bWithin.value)
bPickOne=candidate($bSolveOne.solutions,index=0)
bApplyOne=apply($bPickOne.assignment,in=$bSolveOne.solutions)
aSolve=solve($aProblem.problem,within=$aWithin.value)
bSolve=solve($bProblem.problem,within=$bWithin.value)
aPick0=candidate($aSolve.solutions,index=0)
aPick1=candidate($aSolve.solutions,index=1)
bPick0=candidate($bSolve.solutions,index=0)
bPick1=candidate($bSolve.solutions,index=1)
aApply0=apply($aPick0.assignment,in=$aSolve.solutions)
aApply1=apply($aPick1.assignment,in=$aSolve.solutions)
bApply0=apply($bPick0.assignment,in=$bSolve.solutions)
bApply1=apply($bPick1.assignment,in=$bSolve.solutions)
made0=assemble(Assembly.fragments,on=@v/G,along=Assembly.interfaces,a=@v/A,b=@v/B,ma=@v/ma,mb=@v/mb,local.a=$aApply0.object,local.b=$bApply0.object)
made1=assemble(Assembly.fragments,on=@v/G,along=Assembly.interfaces,a=@v/A,b=@v/B,ma=@v/ma,mb=@v/mb,local.a=$aApply1.object,local.b=$bApply1.object)
madeConflict=assemble(Assembly.fragments,on=@v/G,along=Assembly.interfaces,a=@v/A,b=@v/B,ma=@v/ma,mb=@v/mb,local.a=$aApply0.object,local.b=$bApplyOne.object)
madePartial=assemble(Assembly.fragments,on=@v/G,along=Assembly.interfaces,a=@v/A,b=@v/B,ma=@v/ma,mb=@v/mb,local.a=$aApply0.object)
mixedOwner=assemble(Assembly.fragments,on=@v/G,along=Assembly.interfaces,a=@v/A,b=@v/B,ma=@v/ma,mb=@v/mb,local.a=$bApply0.object)
shared=evaluate(Assembly.ownerOf,p=@v/ma,on=$made0.object)
globalZero=check(Assembly.boundary,p=@v/a,on=$made0.object)
globalOne=check(Assembly.boundary,p=@v/a,on=$made1.object)
